_meta.power_mismatch_explanation: 95 level rows have power_game != power_computed (>10%). Root cause: two patterns. (1) 5 nodes in tab 3 (sci_id 30019200) have effect_type='50108;0.1': stat 50108 has power_extra=30000 and the game uses a secondary power calculation that adds to the primary stat power using this extra coefficient; our extractor only computes primary_stat_value * primary_power_coeff, missing the secondary contribution. (2) 90 nodes in tab 12 have effect_type='1;10145000': type=1 indicates the game uses an absolute-value HP stat (stat type 5) with a non-standard power formula where the second component (10145000) acts as a reference multiplier or base HP pool; our extractor uses the raw lw_effect_number power_coeff (0.5) without this multiplier, yielding power_computed that is ~173x lower than power_game. RESOLUTION: power_game is always authoritative. Engine MUST use power_game as the definitive power delta. power_computed is a cross-check only and should not be used for game logic or UI display when power_game > 0.
_meta.time_condition_explanation: time_condition field format: 'type;value' where type=1 means season/event window (value is the event/season ID, e.g. 57). type=99, value=999 is a disabled/unreleased placeholder. All rows with time_condition also have onlyInActivity=1. 178 level rows have time_condition (all in tab 9 Alliance Duel nodes): 177 with type=1,value=57 (available during event 57) and 1 with type=99,value=999 (disabled).
_meta.tab_names_resolution: All 18 tab names resolved from aps_science_tab table + en.bin locale binary scan. Tabs 14/15/16 (Tank Mastery/Missile Mastery/Aircraft Mastery) required direct binary scan as their name keys (tech_name_14/15/16) are not indexed in the standard locale parse path. Tabs 1-9 use numeric locale IDs (200001-200010). Tabs 10-13, 17-18 use named locale keys.
